about: 원가생성/수정(E040802) — 2026-10-12 원본 실측: 한 줄 = 원가 기간. 열 [기준년월 · 원가계산방법 · 계산기준 · 사전작업 · 원가계산 · 원가현황 · 기타], 맨 위 줄만 버튼을 펼친다. [신규] 기본등록(시작월 잠김 = 앞 기간 다음 달 · 종료월 · 원가계산법 · 외주비기준) 저장 → 맨 위에 새 줄 + 원가생성전 점검사항이 뜬다 → 표준원가생성 · 생성 → [수정] 이 붙는다 → 삭제(복구되지 않습니다) 하면 줄이 사라진다. 기간을 지우면 그 기간 노무비/경비 줄도 사라진다(원본 = 우리, 2026-10-20).

shots.name: 신규 기간 → 점검사항 → 표준원가생성 · 생성 → 수정 창 → 삭제
steps: wait:2000
expect:[...document.querySelector('table thead tr').cells].map((c) => c.innerText.trim()).join('|') === '기준년월|원가계산방법|계산기준|사전작업|원가계산|원가현황|기타'

js:(async () => { const W = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const B = (t, root = document) => [...root.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.innerText.trim() === t); sessionStorage.setItem('cpBefore', document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr').length); B('신규(F2)').click(); await W(500); return document.querySelector('input[aria-label="시작월"]').value + ' ' + document.querySelector('input[aria-label="시작월"]').disabled })()

expect:(() => { const B = (t, root = document) => [...root.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.innerText.trim() === t); const dlg = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop(); return dlg.innerText.includes('기본등록') && ['총평균법', '선입선출법', '최종매입원가법', '품목등록', '실외주비'].every((t) => dlg.innerText.includes(t)) && !!B('저장(F8)', dlg) && !!B('다시 작성', dlg) })()

js:(async () => { const W = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const B = (t, root = document) => [...root.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.innerText.trim() === t); const s = document.querySelector('input[aria-label="시작월"]').value; sessionStorage.setItem('cpStart', s); B('저장(F8)', [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop()).click(); await W(1500); return s })()

expect:document.body.innerText.includes('원가생성전 점검사항') && document.querySelector('tbody tr td').innerText.trim() === sessionStorage.getItem('cpStart').replace('-', '/') + ' ~ ' + sessionStorage.getItem('cpStart').replace('-', '/')

expect:(() => { const d = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop(); return ['1. 반제품과 제품의 생산공정이', '6. 세트품목은 제품과 상품만'].every((t) => d.innerText.includes(t)) && !!d.querySelector('table.ec-report') })()

js:(async () => { const W = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const B = (t, root = document) => [...root.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.innerText.trim() === t); B('닫기', [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop()).click(); await W(300); B('노무비/경비등록').click(); await W(1500); return [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop().innerText.slice(0, 40) })()

expect:(() => { const d = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop(); return d.getAttribute('aria-label') === '노무비/경비' && d.innerText.includes('기준월: ' + sessionStorage.getItem('cpStart').replace('-', '/')) && [...d.querySelectorAll('thead th')].map((t) => t.innerText.trim()).join('|') === '공정명|창고코드|창고명|노무비|경비' && d.innerText.includes('합계') })()

js:(async () => { const W = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const B = (t, root = document) => [...root.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.innerText.trim() === t); const d = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop(); const inp = [...d.querySelectorAll('input')].find((x) => (x.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').endsWith(' 노무비')); const set = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; set.call(inp, '1000'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); await W(200); B('저장(F8)', d).click(); await W(1500); const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const rows = await (await fetch('/api/process-expenses?period=' + sessionStorage.getItem('cpStart'), { headers: H })).json(); sessionStorage.setItem('cpExp', rows.length); B('노무비/경비등록').click(); await W(1500); return inp.getAttribute('aria-label') + ' → ' + rows.length + '줄' })()
expect:Number(sessionStorage.getItem('cpExp')) >= 1 && [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop().innerText.includes('1,000')

js:(async () => { const W = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const B = (t, root = document) => [...root.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.innerText.trim() === t); B('닫기', [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop()).click(); await W(300); window.confirm = (m) => { window.__confirm = m; return true }; B('표준원가생성').click(); await W(2000); window.__stdConfirm = window.__confirm; B('생성').click(); await W(500); sessionStorage.setItem('cpGenWin', [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop().innerText); B('적용(F8)', [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop()).click(); await W(2500); return 'ok' })()

expect:(() => { const w = sessionStorage.getItem('cpGenWin'); return w.includes('원가생성') && w.includes('전체') && w.includes('선택공정') && String(window.__confirm).startsWith('생성처리를 하겠습니까?') && String(window.__stdConfirm).endsWith('표준원가를 생성하겠습니까?') })()

expect:(() => { const B = (t, root = document) => [...root.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.innerText.trim() === t); return document.body.innerText.includes('원가생성] 작업이 완료되었습니다') && !!B('수정', document.querySelector('tbody tr')) })()

js:(async () => { const W = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const B = (t, root = document) => [...root.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.innerText.trim() === t); B('수정', document.querySelector('tbody tr')).click(); await W(600); return [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop().innerText.slice(0, 60) })()
expect:[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop().innerText.includes('원가수정')

js:(async () => { const W = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const B = (t, root = document) => [...root.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.innerText.trim() === t); B('닫기', [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop()).click(); await W(300); window.confirm = () => true; B('삭제', document.querySelector('tbody tr')).click(); await W(1500); return 'ok' })()
expect:document.body.innerText.includes('원가삭제] 작업이 완료되었습니다') && document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr').length === Number(sessionStorage.getItem('cpBefore'))

js:(async () => { const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const rows = await (await fetch('/api/process-expenses?period=' + sessionStorage.getItem('cpStart'), { headers: H })).json(); sessionStorage.setItem('cpExpAfter', rows.length); return '삭제 뒤 노무비/경비 ' + rows.length + '줄' })()
expect:sessionStorage.getItem('cpExpAfter') === '0'
